metadata.title: Swinging Sixties British Invasion Album Cover

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast collage featuring a white London-style street sign as a central frame, overlaid with a Union Jack-patterned electric guitar. The background is a washed-out, painterly street scene with pops of primary colors, creating a nostalgic yet vibrant British aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: The guitar body overlaps the street sign to create depth.
The red and blue of the Union Jack echo the text colors.
The street sign acts as a container for the primary title text.
The background imagery is desaturated to ensure the foreground elements pop.
coreInvariants: Union Jack motif on the guitar body
Sans-serif typography in black and red
Vertical guitar orientation leaning slightly right

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The street sign occupies the upper two-thirds; the guitar is scaled to span the full height of the sign and slightly below.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The Union Jack guitar body at the bottom-right of the sign.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold black title text down to the guitar, then following the guitar neck upward, finally settling on the red sub-text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space within the street sign and at the bottom footer to maintain legibility.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on the guitar and text against a low-saturation, high-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for primary titles
Slightly condensed proportions for secondary information
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard geometric clarity
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold black sans-serif for impact paired with condensed red sans-serif for informational hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Rounded rectangle border for the sign
Horizontal divider line within the sign
Union Jack flag wrap on 3D object

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and feel of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage with a faded, watercolor-style London street background. In the center, place a white rectangular street sign with a black border and a horizontal line near the bottom. Lean a detailed electric guitar with a Union Jack flag paint job against the right side of the sign.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold black uppercase sans-serif text in the top section of the sign. Add red uppercase sans-serif text in the bottom section of the sign and in the footer area below the sign.

verificationChecks: Is the guitar body patterned with the Union Jack?
Is the main title text black and uppercase?
Does the street sign have a thin black border?
Is the background desaturated compared to the foreground elements?

mustAchieve: Vibrant primary colors on the guitar
Clear visual separation between sign and background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the guitar neck does not obscure the main title legibility.
Ensure the Union Jack colors are vibrant red and blue.
Verify the street sign looks like a physical object in the scene.
Confirm the footer text is centered and balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: London Street Sign + Union Jack Instrument + Bold Sans-Serif Typography + Faded Urban Backdrop
